cancer_case.smoking_history: Former smoker, 30 pack-years, quit 5 years ago
cancer_case.clinical_notes: Patient presents with persistent cough and hemoptysis. CT chest shows 3.5cm mass in right upper lobe with mediastinal lymphadenopathy. PET-CT confirms N2 disease. Brain MRI negative for metastases. EBUS-TBNA confirms adenocarcinoma in mediastinal nodes. Molecular testing reveals EGFR exon 19 deletion. Performance status ECOG 1. No significant comorbidities.

expected_treatment: First-line EGFR TKI (Osimertinib) given EGFR mutation, with consideration for local therapy (surgery or radiation) after response assessment
trial_eligibility: Eligible for EGFR TKI trials, neoadjuvant immunotherapy trials, combination therapy trials
